decisions.decision: The Rust DLL owns complete message production; Lua remains a thin X4 getter/callback adapter.
decisions.rationale: D-12 keeps testable state, identity, canonicalization, digest, completion and retry behavior in Rust while Lua only bridges game-owned APIs.

decisions.decision: decoded_bytes is not part of the wire or completion contract.
decisions.rationale: D-13 removes receiver-internal memory estimates from sender authority while retaining enforceable local resource bounds.

decisions.decision: Reconnect is a protocol-generation fence, not only a named-pipe reconnect.
decisions.rationale: A replacement bridge requires bootstrap-first compatibility and must not inherit an incomplete candidate from the old transport epoch.
